all_quick_tuner_timings.justification: The pattern from iter 7 and 8 shows that pushing scheduler latency down (8 ms vs 24 ms) and keeping cores in POLL idle state with high busy-poll consistently cuts tail-latency below 5 ms.  I will probe an even more aggressive setting: shrink min_granularity and latency another 2× and raise min_perf_pct to 60 % to eliminate DVFS-induced stalls, while retaining POLL and busy_poll to preserve the low-latency path.  This tests whether the sweet-spot can be driven still lower without crossing into dangerous starvation depths (< 1 ms).
